root_idea.summary: The root centers on the distinctive complexion, coloration, or visible character of a thing.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from visible color and differing appearance to generalized varieties or kinds, and in derived forms to variation in state or disposition. Classical sources also connect a date variety and the noun لِينَةٌ, “palm,” with this root; these are lexical-development notes rather than additional Quranic senses of لَوْن.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The canonical Quranic noun is displayed under its normalized singular citation form لَوْن.

senses.definition: Color or visible hue—the distinguishing appearance of a thing.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural أَلْوَان, the term can emphasize differing colors and the distinct visible forms or complexions of people and things. This Quranic use concerns coloration and appearance, not the broader Classical extension to kinds or species.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A generalized use of the noun beyond physical coloration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sort, species, kind, or variety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَلْوَانُ الأَطْعِمَةِ denotes kinds or varieties of foods; the same lexical branch can include a kind or variety of dates. This is a broader Classical usage than the Quranic color sense.
A figurative use describing a person's characteristic temperament or character.
Classical Form II usage attested intransitively for something acquiring a color.
Used with فِي الكَلَامِ for variation in manner or expression of speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become coloured, variegated, or diversified in color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical Form V usage describing the acquisition or variation of coloration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vary in state or condition, or to assume various forms or appearances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived-form use for changeability in condition or outward appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vary in disposition or become changeable in temperament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person whose disposition varies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Varying, changeable, or unsteady in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active-participial description of a person characterized by instability of temperament.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Illustrative date example; it adds no lexical meaning beyond acquiring color.
Cross-referenced color-change use covered by the broader Form V color meaning.
Variation in state, condition, or appearance.
The unit contains the color, distinctive-quality, kind/species, and disposition branches.
Kinds or varieties of foods in the cited plural expression.
Unsteadiness in disposition is covered by the participial meaning.

cautions: All nine Quranic occurrences are nominal. The Form II, Form V, and participial entries are broader Classical Arabic evidence, not additional Quranic form groups.
